notes.title: Galaxy Highways is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

After 5 years of development alongside our full-time jobs and families, Galaxy Highways is finally here! We poured our hearts and a piece of ourselves into this game, and we're incredibly happy to finally share the full experience with you.

So far, the feedback has been amazing. We’re receiving so many positive feedback here on Steam and also across social media. It truly means the world to us. [b]Thank you![/b] 

[h2]What to expect in the full version[/h2]

[h3]🎮 18 handcrafted pixel-art levels across 3 story chapters[/h3]
Each chapter featuring a unique enemy faction from the Mantis species. Every enemy is little bit different and has it's own unique attacks.

[h3]🚀 3 playable ships, each with distinct primary weapons and stats to match your playstyle[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Incruster[/b] – A balanced all-rounder with average HP, DPM, and dash energy regeneration.
[*] [b]Bulldog[/b] – A fast but fragile glass cannon with powerful laser attacks and high DPM, but much lower HP.
[*] [b]Arrowhead[/b] – A tanky missile ship with high HP and larger size, but slower movement, lower DPM, and weaker dash regeneration.
[/list]
[h3]🧨 13 additional secondary and special weapons to create your build[/h3]
7 secondary and 6 special weapons, each with unique visuals and mechanics including rail gun, missiles, homing missiles, arc gun, defend turrets, mines, blast waves, and more.

[h3]⚙️ Temporary level upgrades and permanent upgrades[/h3]
Dock serve as upgrade hub, with each upgrade represented by a base building. You can upgrade your ship HP, primary weapon damage, dash regeneration, temporary upgrade (boost) time limits, continual reload and more.

Some of the upgrades can also be unlocked through optional side missions with their own unique enemy challenges.

[h3]👾 11 unique boss fights[/h3]
Each boss has distinct mechanics, plus a variety of mini-bosses like various mantis battleships, space stations, and enemy convoys.

[h3]📘 A sci-fi story[/h3]
Fully voiced animated comic cutscenes (with subtitles), text-based briefing dialogues and in-game dialogue during missions.

[h3]🏆26 Steam achievements[/h3]

[h3]🎨🎵ArtBook and Coloring Book DLC + Original Soundtrack[/h3]
Alongside the full game, we’ve also released Digital ArbBook and Coloring Book DLC and Original Galaxy Highways Soundtrack so don't forget to check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3721090/Galaxy_Highways__Digital_Artbook_and_Coloring_book/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3722110/Galaxy_Highways_Soundtrack/

[h2]💡 What’s next?[/h2]
The release is just the beginning! We’re actively gathering your feedback and already working on a post-launch update that will include small improvements, feature suggestions, and ideas that didn’t make it into the initial release.

You can also join our [url=https://discord.gg/vJ8QdVv]Discord[/url] for bug reports or any feedback!

[b]Thank you all so much for your support![/b] Enjoy the game and stay with us, because there’s more to come!

Roman and Stano, Galaxy Highways Team

notes.title: Help us translate Galaxy Highways!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

As you might know, we're a small indie studio with limited resources, and unfortunately, we can't afford professional translations into all the languages we'd love to support. But we really want our game to be accessible to as many players as possible around the globe.

That's why we're excited to announce the launch of community translations through [url=https://www.localizor.com/galaxy-highways]Localizor[/url] and we invite you to help us bring the game into your native language. 

[h2]We're offering some great rewards for contributors:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Steam key for the full game
[*] Digital version of our Art Book
[*] Digital version of our Coloring Book
[*] Your name credited in the game
[/list]

[h2]Here's how you can start:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Head over to our game's page on [url=https://www.localizor.com/galaxy-highways]Localizor[/url]
[*] Carefully read the translation guidelines and rules.
[*] Start translating and contribute to your language!
[/list]

Once you've contributed enough, reach out to us on our [url=https://discord.gg/vJ8QdVv]Discord server[/url], where we have a dedicated #community-translations channel to support translators and answer any questions you may have.

Thank you very much for your support and enthusiasm! Together, let's make our game accessible to players everywhere.

Happy translating!

Roman and Stano, Galaxy Highways Team

notes.title: New Demo & Pre-release Trailer
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve got some great news for you!

[b]First and foremost, we’ve just released a brand-new demo here on Steam.[/b] Compared to the old one, this updated demo includes a ton of new features and improvements, and truly represents where the game is at before release. Here’s a quick rundown of the main additions:

[list]
[*] Scaled-Up Player Ships for better visibility and improved gameplay
[*] Enhanced Visuals for all weapons and their upgrades
[*] More Weapon Upgrades available in docks
[*] All-New, Larger Explosions and other visual effects
[*] New Parallax Scrolling Effect that helps reduce motion sickness
[*] Automatic Switching between keyboard/mouse and gamepad controls at any point in the game (no menu visit required)
[*] New “Snakes Hole” Level featuring a brand-new type of “Snake” enemies
[*] New Snake Boss Fight
[*] Boss Re-Spawn Functionality with the option to choose a temporary boost if you die mid-fight
[*] Revamped Defense Missions
[*] New Player HP + Dash Energy UI
[*] Overall Polish and UI Improvements throughout the game and in the hangar
[*] And a lot more...
[/list]

These are just some of the highlights—there’s so much new content and polish that it’s hard to list everything!

[b]We’ve also revamped our Steam page with brand-new screenshots and prepared a completely new pre-release trailer. [/b]

[previewyoutube=mH83wo9Q6oU;full][/previewyoutube]

We’d love for you to try out our new demo and share your thoughts, whether here in the discussion forum or on our [url=http://discord.gg/vJ8QdVv]Discord[/url]

Stay tuned for more updates!

Sincerely,

Roman & Stano - Galaxy Highways team

notes.title: Galaxy Highways News
notes.content:
Dear players,

We wanted to let you know that we've decided to shift our game's release to Q1 2025.

We understand that we've postponed the launch a few times already, and we truly appreciate your patience and support. As just two developers juggling full-time jobs and family life with kids, the development has been more challenging and time-consuming than we initially thought.

Please know that we're committed and working hard to make the best game possible. We don't want to cut corners, we want to deliver something that both we and you will be proud of.

To make up for the delay, we would like to reveal our latest boss - the colossal Mantis Mining Station. Alongside its electric blasts, arc waves and projectile barrages, it launches defensive fighters to challenge you.

[previewyoutube=eCQTZZjHZUQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for sticking with us on this journey. We can't wait to share the finished product with you.

Sincerely,

[Roman & Stano - Galaxy Highways team]

notes.title: Steam SHMUP festival and major demo update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I've got some exciting news for our game, and I can't wait to share it with you all! Our game is currently taking part in the Steam SHMUP festival, and we've prepared a major update for our demo for this event. I'd like to go over the exciting new features we've introduced to our game, and I hope you'll enjoy them while playing our free demo. Here are the most important added features:

[h1]Settings and Input rebinding[/h1]
[list]
[*] We've added various settings for our game, including audio, graphics, gameplay, controls, and language settings.
[*] We've implemented input (keyboard/gamepad) rebinding so players can freely rebind controls to their liking!
[*] We currently support any Xbox or PS-type controllers in our game.
[*] All settings are saved and loaded when players run the game again.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963628/b6f4550c61596cc037764c1c4524dc375480bc0b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963628/a13a2692f9420c50d6a9c5331e1809a13b8dcca2.png[/img]
[h1]Weapon improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] All weapons are now continually reloaded, and continual reload speed can be upgraded by buying or obtaining permanent upgrades in levels.
[*] The weapon assignment screen now displays all weapons, including primary weapon stats and descriptions.
[*] New upgrade/unlock weapon animations, including weapon tier display on the research screen.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963628/bd9e60cb214a0f144f7f4258268eb2cc58af1dd0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963628/cc6b17e93534d7f6d9f51ff59c9085779f697425.png[/img]
[h1]Hangar and ship selection screens[/h1]
[list]
[*] The hangar screen has received a complete makeover. Now, all your weapons, including primary, secondary, and special, are conveniently grouped together at the bottom of the screen.
[*] Ship information now includes both base and upgraded values for each attribute (except boost time limit and continual reload, which depend on boost or weapon, so we display "Per Boost" or "Per Weapon").
[*] Ship selection screen has a fresh new look. Now, you can easily view both base and upgraded stats for all available ships!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963628/3665696d8d2fe4c49dd900b3a0a3a7d0d64535db.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963628/34ba5146af7cd560c29a163aeb4c55febdf4941f.png[/img]
[h1]New dock upgrades screen[/h1]
[list]
[*] In our game, you acquire upgrades for your ships by completing optional or mandatory objectives within levels. Now, you also have the option to purchase these upgrades using credits on this new screen.
[*] On the upgrades screen, you'll find all available upgrades (dock buildings). Each dock building has multiple tiers, and each tier enhances your ship's capabilities, such as HP, primary weapons, boost time limits, continual reload, and more.
[*] Upon purchasing a new upgrade, the corresponding building will appear in your docks, resulting in upgraded ships.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963628/f8e716d106e01f60aefab12c186e2925d1f0ed4d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963628/ddff9e5c98577beaaa49727f0ef2ea6c85790860.png[/img]

These are only the most important updates, and we've improved and polished our demo a lot with many other features.

We would love to hear your feedback, and we hope you'll enjoy playing our new demo!

[b]Consider to Wishlist our game[/b] if you haven't done that already 😉

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1650370/Galaxy_Highways/

You can also [b]join our [url=discord.gg/vJ8QdVv]discord[/url][/b] for some more news, discussions, bug reporting or to join our testing squad.

Stay tuned!

Galaxy Highways Team.
